description: A man with grey powdered hair in a burgundy velvet coat, pale blue waistcoat and white cravat stands raising his right hand as if swearing an oath, his left hand on an open book on a wooden table. Other men in dark late 18th-century coats raise their hands behind him, with candles and tall windows in a dim interior. The open book shows legible printed words, including SERMENT and CONSTITUTION. A small sparkle logo sits in the bottom-right corner. The painting fills the image with no frame.
reason: Shows a late 18th-century oath-taking scene in an interior, not Monet's Impression, Sunrise, a hazy harbour seascape of 1872. The dress and setting are 1780s-90s, not 1872. The open book has painted words SERMENT and CONSTITUTION that must go.
